purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for the Veil revision-scars fixture.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for routine Airawa flower grooming, the recertification rupture, ecological cross-reading, adjudicator containment, disclosure choices, and state-gated aftermaths.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the court establishing view, coworker routine, the anomalous flower closeup, the waiting queue, maintenance-scent rupture, adjudicator arrival, witness affordances, containment fold, final disclosure threshold, and each ending family. The moment Nara's conscious memory agrees while the body contradicts it stands alone.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt describes a complete frame with visible geometry, materials, lighting, bodies, tools, ecological witnesses, and staging in plain visual language. Prompt assembly includes only the visual refs for characters present in that frame. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: painterly bioluminescent alien natural-history illustration for mature interactive fiction, precise six-limbed anatomy, tactile bark and wet biological materials, restrained teal green amber and purple light, dry workplace observation turning into quiet body horror, cinematic composition with readable staging and expressive nonhuman posture.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each image prompt from global_style_cue, the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for visible named characters or groups, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Every render starts from its full assembled text or the declared camera-specific scene-set blockout.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide cutaway view of a tall oval chamber grown around a massive pale tree root used as imperial memory infrastructure. Three narrow bark-and-resin grooming ledges cross the middle height and face a translucent green biological membrane. A shallow silver repair basin sits in the correction bay behind the membrane beside a dark oval archive socket. At floor level, an amber-beaded fungal road enters through a low arch and stops at a black circular quarantine band. Climbing ridges run vertically along the rear root. Narrow high vents frame a huge fixed companion planet in the dim sky. Cold blue bioluminescent seams shift toward green during eclipse ingress; wet bark, woven fungal cables, grown plates, and resin rails make the chamber visibly alive and administrative.
visual_continuity_notes: The court is one tall oval root chamber. Bottom road threshold, middle ledges, membrane and correction bay, rear climbing ridge, and upper inspection iris remain in the same vertical order.
The translucent membrane has a lower pass-through that opens during recertification, allowing access from the grooming ledges to the repair basin.

review_notes: The accepted B-level visual plan includes a draft scene_set map, fixed zones, camera slots, sightline lanes, and branch-persistent spatial states.
Every base image prompt is standalone and translates Airawa anatomy, court geometry, ecological witnesses, materials, and lighting into visible terms.
